header.name: EssentialCC §r(§a1.0.5§r)
header.description: §aA powerful utility script for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition by providing more tweaks and commands in your game.

settings.text:
§lEssentialCC§r
§6NOTE: Changing these settings requires you to restart the world to apply the changes.

Commands Cooldown
§iThis is used by non-operator commands to cooldown the usage
settings.name: essentialcc:commands_cooldown

settings.text:
Max Warps
§iThe maximum warps that a player can have
settings.name: essentialcc:max_warps

settings.text:
§lAllow commands§r
§iEnable or disable commands through these togglable setting to maximize your preference.

/warp §i[Usable by Members]
§iTeleport to the location of the specified warp.
settings.name: essentialcc:warp

settings.text:
/warplist §i[Usable by Members]
§iList all warps available.
settings.name: essentialcc:warplist

settings.text:
/setwarp §i[Usable by Members]
Set a warp location with your current location.
settings.name: essentialcc:setwarp

settings.text:
/delwarp §i[Usable by Members]
Delete the specified warp.
settings.name: essentialcc:delwarp

settings.text:
/home §i[Usable by Members]
Teleport to the location of your home.
settings.name: essentialcc:home

settings.text:
/sethome §i[Usable by Members]
Set your own home location.
settings.name: essentialcc:sethome

settings.text:
/suicide §i[Usable by Members]
Cause yourself to die instantly.
settings.name: essentialcc:suicide

settings.text:
/tps §i[Usable by Members]
Check your the server's tick per seconds.
settings.name: essentialcc:tps

settings.text:
/ban §i[Only for Operators]
Permanently ban a player from the server.
settings.name: essentialcc:ban

settings.text:
/tempban §i[Only for Operators]
Temporarily ban a player from the server.
settings.name: essentialcc:tempban

settings.text:
/banlist §i[Only for Operators]
List all the names of banned players.
settings.name: essentialcc:banlist

settings.text:
/burn §i[Only for Operators]
Set a player on fire in a seconds.
settings.name: essentialcc:burn

settings.text:
/kickall §i[Only for Operators]
Kick all players within the game except the issuer.
settings.name: essentialcc:kickall

settings.text:
/lockdimension §i[Only for Operators]
Lock a dimension to prevent players teleporting in this dimension.
settings.name: essentialcc:lockdimension

settings.text:
/unlockdimension §i[Only for Operators]
Unlock a dimension to let players teleport to this dimension.
settings.name: essentialcc:unlockdimension

settings.text:
/mute §i[Only for Operators]
Mute a player from chatting in the game.
settings.name: essentialcc:mute

settings.text:
/unmute §i[Only for Operators]
Unmute the player from sending chats in the game.
settings.name: essentialcc:unmute

settings.text:
/nickname §i[Only for Operators]
Set a new nickname to a specifc player(s)
settings.name: essentialcc:nickname

settings.text:
/realname §i[Only for Operators]
Show the real gamertag of the specified nickname.
settings.name: essentialcc:realname

settings.text:
/pardon §i[Only for Operators]
Pardon a player that was banned from the server.
settings.name: essentialcc:pardon

settings.text:
/rank §i[Only for Operators]
Manage the ranks in this world.
settings.name: essentialcc:rank

settings.text:
/freeze §i[Only for Operators]
Freeze a player making them unable to move and look around.
settings.name: essentialcc:freeze

settings.text:
/tempfreeze §i[Only for Operators]
Temporarily freeze a player making them unable to move and look around.
settings.name: essentialcc:tempfreeze

settings.text:
/unfreeze §i[Only for Operators]
Unfreeze the player from being unable to move or turn around.
settings.name: essentialcc:unfreeze
